sections.head: Test the apps that read from Snowflake

items.a: Snowflake testing checks that data in Snowflake is correct and that the apps, dashboards and agents built on it show the right values.

items.q: How is this different from dbt tests?
items.a: dbt tests check tables and models. TestMu AI checks that the numbers users see in dashboards, apps and AI answers match the warehouse.
Yes. Streamlit in Snowflake apps are tested like any web app, with values compared to queries.
Yes. Agent answers are compared with warehouse data in the same run.

items.q: Do I need to write code?
items.a: No. Tests are written in plain English with KaneAI or Kane CLI.
